# Preflight: auto-fix rustc warnings before running generators
preflight-fix:
	@cargo fix --workspace --all-targets --allow-dirty --allow-staged

# Ensure CLI entrypoints exist (bootstrap-safe)
ensure-codegen:
	@RUSTFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo run -p gunbc-app --bin gunbc-codegen -- codegen

# Build workspace binaries once for direct tool execution
build-release-bins: ensure-codegen
	@RUSTFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo build --workspace --release --bins

# Lint upsert: fix if needed, then verify
lint-upsert: ensure-codegen preflight-fix
	@RUSTFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo run -p gunbc-app --bin gunbc-pragma
	@cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings || (cargo clippy --fix --workspace --allow-dirty --allow-staged -- -D warnings && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings)

# Generate CLI entrypoints (DAG upsert)
codegen: lint-upsert
	@RUSTFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo run -p gunbc-app --bin gunbc-codegen-dag

# Full build transaction: codegen \u{2192} testgen \u{2192} cargo build
build: codegen testgen
	@RUSTFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo build --all-targets

# Clean build artifacts
clean:
	@cargo clean

testgen: lint-upsert
	@RUSTFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo run -p gunbc-app --bin gunbc-testgen

testgen-check: lint-upsert
	@RUSTFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo run -p gunbc-app --bin gunbc-testgen

# Ensure deps.toml matches canonical generated configuration
deps-config: build-release-bins
	@RUSTFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo run -p gunbc-app --bin gunbc-deps -q --release

# Check if deps.toml is stale
deps-config-check: build-release-bins

# Check if generated Makefile is stale
makegen-check: lint-upsert
	@RUSTFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo run -p gunbc-app --bin gunbc-makegen

# Check if generated bootstrap artifacts are stale
bootstrap-check: lint-upsert
	@RUSTFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo run -p gunbc-app --bin gunbc-bootstrap

# Check if pragma artifacts are stale
pragma-check: lint-upsert
	@RUSTFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo run -p gunbc-app --bin gunbc-pragma

# Verify generated artifacts match their generators
verify: lint-upsert
	@$(MAKE) deps-config-check
	@$(MAKE) makegen-check
	@$(MAKE) bootstrap-check
	@$(MAKE) testgen-check
	@$(MAKE) pragma-check

# Ensure generated artifacts are up to date
verify-fix: lint-upsert
	@$(MAKE) deps-config
	@RUSTFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo run -p gunbc-app --bin gunbc-makegen
	@RUSTFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo run -p gunbc-app --bin gunbc-bootstrap
	@RUSTFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo run -p gunbc-app --bin gunbc-testgen
	@RUSTFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo run -p gunbc-app --bin gunbc-pragma

# fmt-fix: apply formatting (alias for fmt)
fmt-fix:
	@cargo fmt

# lint-fix: auto-fix lint issues where possible
lint-fix: pragma
	@cargo clippy --fix --workspace --allow-dirty --allow-staged -- -D warnings

# Run CI via build DAG (typed units, deterministic keying)
ci: ensure-codegen
